## Research question

How have Atlantic climate variability, vegetation, and human activity shaped the environment around Lake Peixão?

## About the project

My MSc research used leaf-wax biomarkers from Lake Peixão in Serra da Estrela to investigate western Iberian hydroclimate over the last 2,000 years. This work examines connections between North Atlantic atmospheric circulation, local hydroclimate, vegetation, and human activity. The lake archive also supports collaborative studies of longer Holocene records.

## Approach

Leaf-wax biomarkers, stable isotopes, pollen, and complementary sedimentary proxies.
